ideas.pitch: A specialized code editor designed for the Blind Coding event that restricts monitor visibility and relies entirely on advanced voice feedback, syntax audio cues, and LLM-assisted structural error reporting.
ideas.title: BlindCoder IDE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the unique event format of Code Clash 2.0's Blind Coding challenge, offering a novel tool for practicing and competing in screen-free programming.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance competitive programming testing platform that visually animates complex graph algorithms, dynamic programming state matrices, and tree optimizations in real-time during head-to-head DSA battles.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel Graph Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core theme of the DSA Battle track by providing advanced visualization tools for complex data structures and algorithmic problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent competitive programming assistant that analyzes memory limits, time complexities, and potential edge-case failures of C++ and Python solutions before submission.
ideas.title: SyntaxSync AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the rigorous algorithmic proficiency and problem-solving focus of the DCRUST CSE flagship competitive programming festival.

ideas.pitch: An inter-departmental innovation platform that pairs computer science students with engineering peers from other disciplines to prototype hardware-software solutions for university automation.
ideas.title: CampusCollab CodeHub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the inter-departmental and inter-college nature of DCRUST by bridging different engineering branches for technical creativity.

ideas.pitch: An automated testing harness that benchmarks competitive programming submissions against randomized stress tests to expose hidden runtime bottlenecks and memory leaks.
ideas.title: OptiCode Benchmark Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by solving the problem of automated stress testing and rigorous performance evaluation for algorithmic code.
